name: Samarkand & Bukhara
about: Spring and fall are mild and ideal, summer desert heat is intense, winter is cold.
overview: Silk Road architecture at its most extravagant — Samarkand's turquoise-domed Registan, Bukhara's old-town madrasas and minarets.
costOverview: One of the cheapest destinations in this list — a full plate of plov, the national dish, costs just a dollar or two, and even taxis and historic-site entries stay remarkably cheap.
monthlyWeather: cold, with occasional snow and the year's most precipitation
